Allah (swt) also dislikes speaking during intimacy as it leads to muteness, sleeping between the Maghrib and Isha prayers as it deprives one of sustenance, bathing under the open sky without a covering, entering rivers without a covering because they contain angels, entering bathhouses without a covering, speaking between the call to prayer (Adhan) and the Iqama in the Fajr prayer, sailing the sea when it is turbulent, and sleeping on a roof without a protective barrier.
Prophet (sw) said: "Whoever sleeps on a roof without a protective barrier has absolved himself of responsibility."
Prophet (sw) disliked a person sleeping alone in a house, and He (sw) disliked a man having relations with his wife while she is menstruating. If he does so and the child is born with leprosy or vitiligo, he should blame none but himself.
Prophet (sw) also disliked a man speaking to a person afflicted with leprosy unless there is a distance of at least an arm's length between them."
Prophet (sw) said: "Flee from a leper as you would flee from a lion."
Prophet (sw) disliked a man approaching his wife after having a nocturnal emission until he has performed the ritual purification. If he does so and the child is born mentally impaired, he should blame none but himself.
Prophet (sw) disliked urinating on the bank of a flowing river, and he disliked relieving oneself under a fruit-bearing tree or palm tree.
Prophet (sw) disliked relieving oneself while standing, putting on shoes while standing, and entering a dark house without a lamp.
O' Ali (as), the affliction of noble lineage is arrogance.
O' Ali (as), whoever fears Allah (swt), everything will fear him, and whoever does not fear Allah (swt), Allah (swt) will make him fearful of everything.
O' Ali (as), there are eight types of people whose prayers Allah (swt) does not accept: the runaway slave until he returns to his master, the rebellious wife whose husband is displeased with her, the one who withholds zakat, the one who neglects ablution, the mature girl who prays without a head covering, an imam who leads a congregation that dislikes him, the intoxicated person, and the one who prays while suppressing the urge to urinate or defecate.
O' Ali (as), there are four qualities for which Allah (swt) builds a house in Paradise for the one who possesses them: one who shelters the orphan, has mercy on the weak, is compassionate toward his parents, and treats his servant with kindness.
O' Ali (as), there are three things that if a person meets Allah (swt) with them, he will be among the best of people: whoever fulfills what Allah (swt) has made obligatory upon him, he will be among the most devoted worshippers; whoever abstains from what Allah (swt) has prohibited, he will be among the most pious; and whoever is content with what Allah (swt) has provided for him, he will be among the richest of people.
O' Ali (as), there are three things that this nation cannot bear: sharing one's wealth with his brother, treating people with fairness from oneself, and remembering Allah (swt) in all circumstances. And this remembrance is not merely saying "Subhanallah (swt), Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illa Allah (swt), Allahu Akbar," but it is when one faces something prohibited and fears Allah (swt) and refrains from it.
O' Ali (as), there are three types of people who will wrong you if you treat them with fairness: the lowly, your family, and your servant. And three types of people will never be treated fairly by three others: a free man by a slave, a learned man by an ignorant person, and a strong person by a weak one.
O' Ali (as), seven qualities, if found in a person, complete his faith, and the gates of Paradise are opened for him: one who perfects his ablution, performs his prayer properly, pays the zakat of his wealth, restrains his anger, controls his tongue, seeks forgiveness for his sins, and gives sincere advice to the family of his Prophet.
O' Ali (as), Allah (swt) has cursed three types of people: one who eats alone, one who travels alone in the wilderness, and one who sleeps alone in a house.
O' Ali (as), three things are feared to cause madness: relieving oneself between graves, walking with only one shoe, and sleeping alone.
O' Ali (as), there are three situations where lying is permissible: strategizing in war, making a promise to your wife, and reconciling between people.
O' Ali (as), three things kill the heart: sitting with the lowly, associating with the wealthy, and engaging in idle talk with women.
O' Ali (as), three things are among the realities of faith: spending in times of hardship, treating people with fairness, and sharing knowledge with those who seek it.
O' Ali (as), three things, if a person does not possess them, his deeds will not be complete: a piety that prevents him from disobeying Allah (swt), good character to interact with people, and patience to withstand the ignorance of the ignorant.
O' Ali (as), there are three joys for a believer in this world: meeting his brothers in faith, breaking the fast of a fasting person, and engaging in prayer in the last part of the night.
O' Ali (as), I warn you against three traits: envy, greed, and arrogance.
O' Ali (as), four traits are signs of misery: dryness of the eyes (lack of tears), hardness of the heart, long aspirations, and love for staying in this world.
O' Ali (as), there are three levels, three expiations, three destructive qualities, and three saving virtues. As for the levels, they are: performing ablution thoroughly in hardship, waiting for the next prayer after finishing one, and walking to congregational prayers day and night.
As for the expiations, they are: spreading peace, feeding others, and praying at night while people are asleep.
As for the destructive qualities, they are: obeying greed, following desires, and self-admiration.
And as for the saving virtues, they are: fearing Allah (swt) in secret and in public, moderation in wealth and poverty, and speaking words of justice in times of pleasure and displeasure.
O' Ali (as), there is no nursing after weaning, and no orphanhood after reaching maturity.
O' Ali (as), travel for two years to be dutiful to your parents, travel for one year to maintain ties of kinship, travel for a mile to visit the sick, travel for two miles to follow a funeral procession, travel for three miles to accept an invitation, travel for four miles to visit a brother in faith, travel for five miles to help someone in distress, and travel for six miles to support the oppressed. And always engage in seeking forgiveness.
O' Ali (as), a believer has three signs: prayer, almsgiving, and fasting.
A pretentious person has three signs: he flatters when present, backbites when absent, and rejoices over people's misfortunes.
A tyrant has three signs: he oppresses those beneath him with force, disobeys those above him, and sides with other oppressors.
A hypocrite has three signs: he lies when he speaks, breaks his promises, and betrays when entrusted.
O' Ali (as), nine things cause forgetfulness: eating sour apples, eating coriander, eating cheese, drinking the leftover of a mouse, reading inscriptions on graves, walking between two women, throwing lice away, cupping at the crown of the head, and urinating in stagnant water.
O' Ali (as), the essence of a good life lies in three things: a spacious home, a beautiful spouse, and a well-bred horse.

_source.chapter: Chapter on Rare Cases, and it is the Last Chapter of the Book (man La Yahduruhu Al faqih)
_source.arabic:
5762 - رَوَى حَمَّادُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو وَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ ، عَنِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَهُ: "يَا عَلِيُّ أُوصِيكَ بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَاحْفَظْهَا فَلاَ تَزَالُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا حَفِظْتَ وَصِيَّتِي يَا عَلِيُّ مَنْ كَظَمَ غَيْظاً وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى إِمْضَائِهِ أَعْقَبَهُ اَللَّهُ يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ أَمْناً وَ إِيمَاناً يَجِدُ طَعْمَهُ يَا عَلِيُّ مَنْ لَمْ يُحْسِنْ وَصِيَّتَهُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ كَانَ نَقْصاً فِي مُرُوءَتِهِ وَ لَمْ يَمْلِكِ اَلشَّفَاعَةَ يَا عَلِيُّ أَفْضَلُ اَلْجِهَادِ مَنْ أَصْبَحَ لاَ يَهُمُّ بِظُلْمِ أَحَدٍ يَا عَلِيُّ مَنْ خَافَ اَلنَّاسُ لِسَانَهُ فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ اَلنَّارِ ، يَا عَلِيُّ شَرُّ اَلنَّاسِ مَنْ أَكْرَمَهُ اَلنَّاسُ اِتِّقَاءَ فُحْشِهِ" وَ رُوِيَ "شَرِّهِ يَا عَلِيُّ شَرُّ اَلنَّاسِ مَنْ بَاعَ آخِرَتَهُ بِدُنْيَاهُ وَ شَرٌّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَنْ بَاعَ آخِرَتَهُ بِدُنْيَا غَيْرِهِ، يَا عَلِيُّ مَنْ لَمْ يَقْبَلِ اَلْعُذْرَ مِنْ مُتَنَصِّلٍ صَادِقاً كَانَ أَوْ كَاذِباً لَمْ يَنَلْ شَفَاعَتِي يَا عَلِيُّ إِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَحَبَّ اَلْكَذِبَ فِي اَلصَّلاَحِ وَ أَبْغَضَ اَلصِّدْقَ فِي اَلْفَسَادِ يَا عَلِيُّ مَنْ تَرَكَ اَلْخَمْرَ لِغَيْرِ اَللَّهِ سَقَاهُ اَللَّهُ مِنَ اَلرَّحِيقِ اَلْمَخْتُومِ"
َقَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ "لِغَيْرِ اَللَّهِ" قَالَ "نَعَمْ وَ اَللَّهِ صِيَانَةً لِنَفْسِهِ يَشْكُرُهُ اَللَّهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا عَلِيُّ شَارِبُ اَلْخَمْرِ كَعَابِدِ وَثَنٍ يَا عَلِيُّ شَارِبُ اَلْخَمْرِ لاَ يَقْبَلُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ صَلاَتَهُ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْماً فَإِنْ مَاتَ فِي اَلْأَرْبَعِينَ مَاتَ كَافِراً
_source.english:
Hadith.5762 - The Prophet (sw), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said to Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), peace be upon him:
"O' Ali (as), I advise you with a piece of advice, so preserve it, and you will remain in goodness as long as you preserve my advice.
O' Ali (as), whoever suppresses his anger while having the power to act upon it, Allah (swt) will grant him security and faith on the Day of Judgment, and he will taste its sweetness.
O' Ali (as), whoever does not write a good will at the time of his death, it is a deficiency in his dignity, and he shall not possess intercession.
O' Ali (as), the best form of jihad is for one to begin the day without intending to oppress anyone.
O' Ali (as), whoever people fear due to his tongue is among the people of the Fire.
O' Ali (as), the worst of people is he whom others honor out of fear of his foul language."
It has also been narrated: "the worst of people is he who sells his Hereafter for his worldly life, and even worse than that is one who sells his Hereafter for the worldly life of another.
O' Ali (as), whoever does not accept the excuse of a person seeking forgiveness, whether he is truthful or lying, shall not attain my intercession.
O' Ali (as), Allah (swt), the Almighty, loves lying if it brings about reconciliation and hates truthfulness if it causes corruption.
O' Ali (as), whoever abandons intoxicants for reasons other than seeking the pleasure of Allah (swt), Allah (swt) will make him drink from the sealed pure drink (rahiq Al-makhtum) in the Hereafter."
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said: "For other than Allah (swt)?"
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, replied:
"Yes, by Allah (swt), if it is to safeguard himself, Allah (swt) will reward him for it.
O' Ali (as), the drinker of alcohol is like an idol worshipper.
O' Ali (as), the drinker of alcohol, Allah (swt) the Almighty will not accept his prayer for forty days; if he dies within those forty days, he dies as a disbeliever."

_source.chapter: Chapter on Rare Cases, and it is the Last Chapter of the Book (man La Yahduruhu Al faqih)
_source.arabic: : "يَا عَلِيُّ وَ اَللَّهِ لَوْ أَنَّ اَلْوَضِيعَ فِي قَعْرِ بِئْرٍ لَبَعَثَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَيْهِ رِيحاً تَرْفَعُهُ فَوْقَ اَلْأَخْيَارِ فِي دَوْلَةِ اَلْأَشْرَارِ يَا عَلِيُّ مَنِ اِنْتَمَى إِلَى غَيْرِ مَوَالِيهِ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اَللَّهِ وَ مَنْ مَنَعَ أَجِيراً أَجْرَهُ فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اَللَّهِ وَ مَنْ أَحْدَثَ حَدَثاً أَوْ آوَى مُحْدِثاً فَعَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةُ اَللَّهِ"
_source.english:
(Prophet (sw) continued); O' Ali (as), by Allah (swt), if a lowly person were in the depths of a well, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, would send a wind to lift him above the righteous during the rule of the wicked.
O' Ali (as), whoever claims affiliation to other than his masters, upon him is the curse of Allah (swt). Whoever withholds the wages of a hired worker, upon him is the curse of Allah (swt). Whoever introduces an innovation or shelters an innovator, upon him is the curse of Allah (swt).

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5784 - اَلْآنَ حَمِيَ اَلْوَطِيسُ".
_source.english:
Hadith.5784 - The Prophet (sw) said;
"Now the battle (battlefield) has intensified." (Spoken on the Day of Battle of Hunayn)

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5873 - وَ رَوَى اَلْمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنِ اَلصَّادِقِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ : قِيلَ لِلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ يَا اِبْنَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ "أَصْبَحْتُ وَ لِيَ رَبٌّ فَوْقِي وَ اَلنَّارُ أَمَامِي وَ اَلْمَوْتُ يَطْلُبُنِي وَ اَلْحِسَابُ مُحْدِقٌ بِي وَ أَنَا مُرْتَهَنٌ بِعَمَلِي لاَ أَجِدُ مَا أُحِبُّ وَ لاَ أَدْفَعُ مَا أَكْرَهُ وَ اَلْأُمُورُ بِيَدِ غَيْرِي فَإِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَنِي وَ إِنْ شَاءَ عَفَا عَنِّي فَأَيُّ فَقِيرٍ أَفْقَرُ مِنِّي".
_source.english:
Hadith.5873 - Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar narrated from Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq, from his father Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his grandfather Imam Hussain ibn Ali (as), peace be upon them, who said:
"It was said to Imam Hussain ibn Ali (as): "How did you wake up this morning, O' son of the Messenger of Allah (swt)?"
Imam (as) replied: "I woke up with my Lord (azj) above me, the Hellfire before me, death pursuing me, and the reckoning encircling me. I am held accountable by my own deeds. I do not attain what I desire, nor can I repel what I dislike. All matters are in the hands of someone other than myself. If He (swt) wills, He (swt) will punish me, and if He (swt) wills, He (swt) will forgive me. So, who is poorer than me?"

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5763 - اَلْيَدُ اَلْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ اَلْيَدِ اَلسُّفْلَى".
_source.english: Hadith.5763 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The upper hand is better than the lower hand."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5764 - مَا قَلَّ وَ كَفَى خَيْرٌ مِمَّا كَثُرَ وَ أَلْهَى".
_source.english:
Hadith.5764 - The Prophet (sw) said;
"That which is little but sufficient is better than that which is abundant and distracts."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5766 - رَأْسُ اَلْحِكْمَةِ مَخَافَةُ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ".
_source.english:
Hadith.5766 - The Prophet (sw) said;
"The foundation of wisdom is the fear of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5765 - خَيْرُ اَلزَّادِ اَلتَّقْوَى".
_source.english: Hadith.5765 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The best provision (for hereafter) is piety."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5767 - خَيْرُ مَا أُلْقِيَ فِي اَلْقَلْبِ اَلْيَقِينُ".
_source.english:
Hadith.5767 - The Prophet (sw) said;
"The best of things that can be placed in the heart is certainty.

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5768 - اَلاِرْتِيَابُ مِنَ اَلْكُفْرِ".
_source.english: Hadith.5768 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Doubt (in religion) is part of disbelief."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5769 - اَلنِّيَاحَةُ مِنْ عَمَلِ اَلْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ".
_source.english: Hadith.5769 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Wailing is an act of the Age of Ignorance."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5770 - اَلسُّكْرُ جَمْرُ اَلنَّارِ ".
_source.english: Hadith.5770 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Intoxication is a burning coal of the Fire (Hellfire)."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5771 - اَلشِّعْرُ مِنْ إِبْلِيسَ ".
_source.english: Hadith.5771 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Poetry is from Iblis (Satan)."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5772 - اَلْخَمْرُ جِمَاعُ اَلْآثَامِ".
_source.english: Hadith.5772 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Alcohol is the source of all sins."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5773 - اَلنِّسَاءُ حِبَالَةُ اَلشَّيْطَانِ ".
_source.english: Hadith.5773 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Women are the snares of Satan."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5774 - اَلشَّبَابُ شُعْبَةٌ مِنَ اَلْجُنُونِ".
_source.english: Hadith.5774 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Youth is a branch of madness (irrationality)."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5775 - شَرُّ اَلْمَكَاسِبِ كَسْبُ اَلرِّبَا".
_source.english: Hadith.5775 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The worst of earnings is the earning through usury."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5776 - شَرُّ اَلْمَآكِلِ أَكْلُ مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ ظُلْماً".
_source.english:
Hadith.5776 - The Prophet (sw) said;
"The worst of foods (wealth) is consuming the wealth of an orphan unjustly."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5777 - اَلسَّعِيدُ مَنْ وُعِظَ بِغَيْرِهِ".
_source.english: Hadith.5777 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The fortunate one is he who learns a lesson from others."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5778 - اَلشَّقِيُّ مَنْ شَقِيَ فِي بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ".
_source.english:
Hadith.5778 - The Prophet (sw) said;
"The wretched one is he who is destined for wretchedness while in his mother's womb."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5779 - مَصِيرُكُمْ إِلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَذْرُعٍ".
_source.english: Hadith.5779 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Your ultimate destination (grave) is four cubits."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5780 - أَرْبَى اَلرِّبَا اَلْكَذِبُ".
_source.english: Hadith.5780 - The Prophet (sw) said; "The greatest form of usury is lying."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5781 - سِبَابُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِ فُسُوقٌ قِتَالُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِ كُفْرٌ أَكْلُ لَحْمِهِ مِنْ مَعْصِيَةِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حُرْمَةُ مَالِهِ كَحُرْمَةِ دَمِهِ".
_source.english: Hadith.5781 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Insulting a believer is wickedness, fighting a believer is disbelief, consuming his flesh (backbiting) is disobedience to Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, and the sanctity of his wealth is like the sanctity of his blood."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5782 - مَنْ يَكْظِمِ اَلْغَيْظَ يَأْجُرْهُ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ".
_source.english: Hadith.5782 - The Prophet (sw) said; "Whoever suppresses anger, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, will reward him."

_source.chapter: Among the Concise Words of the Messenger of Allah (peace Be Upon him)
_source.arabic: 5783 - مَنْ يَصْبِرْ عَلَى اَلرَّزِيَّةِ يُعَوِّضْهُ اَللَّهُ".
_source.english:
Hadith.5783 - The Prophet (sw) said;
"Whoever is patient during a calamity, Allah (swt) will compensate him."
